purpose: Evaluate DGSI Skill generation, evidence handling, uncertainty, conflict reconciliation, historical Context, serialization and upstream-result ingestion. This suite is not an SFT training dataset.

known_limits: source rights are not cleared for formal SFT
must not be used as training data or final blind holdout in the same comparison
tests ADCS/EPS curation subskills, not direct evidence of DGSI LLM-facing SFT effectiveness

expected_behaviors: transfer to source families not used in skill drafting
known_limits: process holdout only; source cases are public and may occur in foundation-model pretraining
if used to tune Skill, prompt or rubric, retire it from holdout

expected_behaviors: preserve user-supplied observations and cause statements
identify missing ML result, logs and operational context
known_limits: L0 facts only; no complete upstream ML/log/context packet
not included in public repository or portable package

expected_behaviors: preserve unavailable ground truth and empty metrics
flag training/inference scaling-range mismatch for investigation
avoid physical fault localization without corroboration
known_limits: synthetic software acceptance data, not in-orbit telemetry
does not match any of the five user REAL cases
not an L1 training packet, Gold or SFT example
corrected artifact supersedes earlier score-as-threshold field mapping; original retained only as historical evidence
illustrative only; not observed event, not training data

exclusion_rules: No component in this suite is automatically Gold or SFT-authorized.
Do not merge tracks into a single count of independent events.
Do not treat the five user L0 facts as complete L1 examples.
Do not treat AAS RUN-03F as REAL or as evidence for the RW bearing case.
Do not use REV1 development cases as both method-development prompts and final blind holdout.
Keep private/user source files and restricted full-text documents out of public packages.
